doc.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Playing double clarinet with Buddy DeFranco
summary: DeFranco toured Japan and praised his style; they later played double clarinet in Japan, Australia and Paris.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Yes. And then I met, in ’76 he came to Japan. In 1969 the New Gramercy Orchestra and Buddy DeFranco came to Japan. And then after ’76 I met Buddy. And he invited — the Yamaha Corporation invited Buddy, and then I played together. And Buddy said, “Eiji, you’ve got big success. Congratulations.” He said to me, “Eiji you have your own style.”
And then after that I played many, many times double clarinet with Buddy DeFranco, in the tour in Japan, Australia, and ’96 we went to the Paris and I played double clarinet with Buddy DeFranco.
